text: AGENTS.md Settings Row 是 DSH Web 客户端的设置扩展，在通用设置中加入一行，用于查看并打开 harness home 的 AGENTS.md。宿主按 DSH_HOME 或默认的 ~/.dsh 解析路径，界面显示目标文件状态；点击按钮后由系统编辑器打开。Windows 使用 Notepad，macOS 使用 open，其他平台使用 xdg-open。适合需要查看或修改 DSH 会话指令文件的用户，可用 dsh plugin add github:dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings 安装。

AGENTS.md Settings Row adds a DSH Web settings item to open the harness home’s AGENTS.md. It resolves DSH_HOME or ~/.dsh and shows the target. The button uses Notepad on Windows, open on macOS, or xdg-open elsewhere. Install with dsh plugin add github:dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings.

AGENTS.md Settings Row 的功能「查看目标文件」：设置行加载时向宿主读取解析后的 AGENTS.md 路径，并展示文件是否存在。
AGENTS.md Settings Row 的功能「用系统编辑器打开」：点击通用设置中的按钮后，客户端请求宿主打开目标 AGENTS.md，并显示结果或错误。
AGENTS.md Settings Row 的功能「按平台启动编辑器」：宿主在 Windows 使用 Notepad，在 macOS 使用 open，在其他平台使用 xdg-open，打开解析出的 AGENTS.md。
AGENTS.md Settings Row 只处理 harness home 下的 AGENTS.md；修改保存后，指令要到新会话才会生效。

@local/agents-md-settings README · AGENTS.md Settings Row — DeepSeek Harness：DeepSeek Harness reads `AGENTS.md` on every new session, but its UI has no way to
*open* that file. This small bundle adds one row to **Settings → General** that hands
the file to your editor.

<sub>中文说明见文末。</sub>

@local/agents-md-settings README · What it does：Clicking **用记事本打开 / Open in editor** opens the user-global `AGENTS.md` of the
harness home — `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md`, or `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` when `DSH_HOME` is
unset. Nothing else: no telemetry, no network, no changes to the file itself.

On Windows the bundle launches **Notepad** directly. A `.md` file usually has no shell
association, so relying on "open with the default app" would show a picker (or do
nothing at all when started through `cmd /c start`).

@local/agents-md-settings README · How it works：A cordis bundle with a host half and a client half:

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts one row named `agents-md-settings` into the profile |
| `index.js` | host: resolves the harness home, registers `GET /agents-md/path` and `POST /agents-md/open`, launches the editor |
| `client.js` | client: registers the row into the `settings.general.item` slot |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client` declarations |

@local/agents-md-settings README · How it works：The client reads `/agents-md/path` on mount and posts to `/agents-md/open` on click.
The host resolves `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`, falling back to `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, then
launches an editor — `notepad.exe` on Windows, `open` on macOS, `xdg-open` elsewhere.
On Windows it then waits for the Notepad window, restores it, sizes it to 900×640 and
raises it, because a stale saved window placement can make an opened file look like
nothing happened.

@local/agents-md-settings README · How it works：Neither route takes a body or a caller-supplied path, so the only file they can ever
touch is the current user's own `AGENTS.md`.

@local/agents-md-settings README · Install：**Install it as a plugin. Never copy the folder into `node_modules`.** A copied folder
is pruned by the next `pnpm install`, and every plugin install or upgrade runs one —
that is how this bundle can disappear on its own while the patch row that points at it
stays behind. An installed package is a recorded dependency, so later installs keep it.

@local/agents-md-settings README · As a package (recommended)：```
dsh plugin add github:dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings
```

The same string works in the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, which accepts a
package name, a Git address, a tarball or an absolute local path. The installer writes
the dependency into `<profile>/package.json` and applies the bundle's own patch row, so
later installs leave it alone. Restart DeepSeek Harness; the row appears at the bottom
of **Settings → General**.

@local/agents-md-settings README · As a package (recommended)：If the row is missing after a restart, the patch row did not get applied — add it by
hand as shown under *From a local checkout* below.

@local/agents-md-settings README · From a local checkout (development)：Use this while you are editing the source: declare a `link:` dependency on the folder
you are working in.

1. In `<profile>/package.json`, add one dependency:

```json
   "dependencies": {
     "@local/agents-md-settings": "link:<absolute path to the checkout>"
   }
   ```

2. Install it into the profile:

```
   pnpm install --dir <profile>
   ```

`node_modules/@local/agents-md-settings` becomes a link to the checkout, and
   `pnpm-lock.yaml` records it.

@local/agents-md-settings README · From a local checkout (development)：3. Add one row to `<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, matching the existing indentation:

```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: agents-md-settings
         name: "@local/agents-md-settings"
   ```

4. Restart DeepSeek Harness. The row appears at the bottom of **Settings → General**.

If your build exposes the `plugin_manager` tool, `install_bundle` with
`target: "<absolute path to this checkout>"` does steps 1–3 for you.

@local/agents-md-settings README · Uninstall：Uninstall through the same surface: **Settings → Plugins** removes the package and its
patch row. By hand, drop the `@local/agents-md-settings` dependency from
`<profile>/package.json` and the `agents-md-settings` insert row from
`<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, run `pnpm install --dir <profile>` so the folder is
cleaned up, and restart.

@local/agents-md-settings README · Notes and limitations：- **Edits take effect on the next session.** `AGENTS.md` is read once, at the first
  request of a session, and is not watched for external changes.
- **The path follows `DSH_HOME`.** The instruction loader reads `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`,
  or `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` when the variable is unset; this row resolves the same way. A
  hard-coded `~/.dsh` would silently edit an unread file on every machine that moved
  its harness home to another drive, a portable install, or a shared directory.
- **One file of two.** The loader also reads `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/AGENTS.md`
  (`~/.agents/AGENTS.md` by default). This row edits only the harness-home file.
- **Windows only for now**, tested on Windows 11 with the desktop app. macOS and Linux
  use `open` / `xdg-open` but are untested.
- The route listens on the app's own local origin. It opens one fixed file and accepts
  no arguments; it is not a general-purpose "run this" endpoint.
- If the row does not appear, check that the package resolved and that
  `cordis.patch.yml` still parses; a YAML typo prevents the whole patch layer from
  loading.

@local/agents-md-settings README · Version history：| Version | Change |
|---|---|
| 1.0.3 | Resolve the harness home (`$DSH_HOME`, else `~/.dsh`) instead of hard-coding `~/.dsh`, and add `GET /agents-md/path` so the row shows the file it will open. A moved home used to make the row edit a file no session read. |
| 1.0.2 | README: lead with `dsh plugin add github:…` so a new user installs a real package instead of copying the folder into `node_modules` and losing it on the next install. |
| 1.0.1 | README: install as a profile dependency. A folder copied into `node_modules` is deleted by the next `pnpm install`, which is why the row could vanish on its own. |
| 1.0.0 | Works end to end on Windows. Client posts to the route; host launches Notepad and raises its window. |
| 0.7.0 | Removed `detached: true` — on Windows a detached PowerShell never launched the editor, so the route answered `200` while nothing appeared. |
| 0.6.0 | Back to `fetch(POST)`: the desktop shell denies `target="_blank"`, so the anchor-based row of 0.4.0 clicked into nothing. |
| 0.5.0 | Find the Notepad window by title, then restore, resize and foreground it. |
| 0.4.0 | Row rendered as a plain link (later rev

@local/agents-md-settings README · Version history：1. `~` is not expanded by every host entry point — resolve the home directory in the
   host process instead.
2. An `<a target="_blank">` inside the desktop shell may never navigate.
3. On Windows, `spawn(..., { detached: true })` can silently fail to launch the child's
   GUI application.
4. `os.homedir()/.dsh` is the harness home only while `DSH_HOME` is unset. Read the
   variable first; otherwise the plugin edits a file the loader never opens, and
   nothing reports the mismatch.

@local/agents-md-settings README · 中文说明：- 前端挂载时读 `GET /agents-md/path`、点击时发 `POST /agents-md/open`；路径由宿主解析，
  包里不写死任何人的路径。
- 路径与指令加载器一致：先读 `$DSH_HOME`，没有才退回 `~/.dsh`。写死 `~/.dsh` 的版本在
  把数据挪到别的盘（或便携版、ProgramData 共享目录）的机器上，会静默编辑一个没人读的
  文件——文件"打开了"，但下个会话根本读不到。
- Windows 上直接拉起记事本，并且会把窗口还原成 900×640 提到前台（记事本可能记住
  了一个极小的窗口尺寸，看起来就像"没反应"）。
- 安装（推荐）：`dsh plugin add github:dongfangxy/dsh-agents-md-settings`，或在应用里
  走 **设置 → 插件 → Add plugin** 填同一串。安装器会把它写进 profile 的依赖、并应用
  bundle 自带的 patch 行，重启后生效。
- **不要直接把目录拷进 `node_modules`**——下一次 `pnpm install` 会把它当多余包装清掉，
  而 `cordis.patch.yml` 里那行还留着，表现就是"插件莫名其妙不见了"。要改源码时，把依赖
  改成 `link:<本目录绝对路径>` 再 `pnpm install --dir <profile>`，并手动补 `insert` 行。
- 卸载：在 设置 → 插件 里移除；或删掉依赖与 `insert` 行，重新 `pnpm install`，重启。
- 改完保存后，**下一个会话**才生效；当前会话不会重载。
